purpose: Extend and verify official/institutional secondary research for Sud-Vest Oltenia, Sud-Muntenia and Centru without converting project activity, training supply, administrative labour-market context or event-specific recruitment into AI4WORK need-prevalence claims.

promoted_sources.title: Cursuri de (re)calificare organizate de AJOFM Gorj in anul 2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: The official course offer maps institutional supply only. It does not measure demand, skill-gap prevalence or AI-specific need and contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Programe de formare profesionala planificate de AJOFM Dambovita pentru anul 2025
promoted_sources.verification_note: The official PDF resolved with source-exact parsed text. A screenshot fetch was attempted but the provider returned 404 for the binary image path; no fact was inferred from an unavailable image.
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: A planned training catalogue is supply context, not a measurement of employer/adult demand, competence deficit or AI4WORK need prevalence. It contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Raport asupra activitatii AJOFM Covasna, situatiei somajului, programelor de ocupare si formare profesionala, pentru anul 2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: These are administrative training and placement outcomes under an explicitly constrained budget/supply environment. They do not represent population prevalence of digital/AI skill gaps, do not support causal attribution and contribute zero H1-H5 points.

Sud-Vest Oltenia.current_complement: S55 maps the 2025 AJOFM Gorj training catalogue, including a 90-hour digital competence program, strictly as supply context.

Sud-Muntenia.current_complement: S56 maps the 2025 AJOFM Dambovita training plan, including digital competence and data-entry/processing training, strictly as supply context.

Centru.current_complement: S57 adds source-exact Covasna evidence that the planned training volume materially exceeded realized provision under an insufficient budget and documents restricted offer/low activation/low placement; this is supply-constraint triangulation only.

refresh_conclusion: The controlled Source_register and Dashboard now reconcile through S57 with one new official supply/supply-constraint row for each target region. All three additions are zero-weight for H1-H5 and neither project activity nor training supply is promoted as evidence of need prevalence. No eligible immutable real adult+employer response export exists, therefore NF06 PROD and downstream synthesis/ranking remain fail-closed. The substantive remaining boundary is live/account-specific/provider-bound rather than methodological.
